curriculum_name: Ephphatha: The 365-Day Salvation History Bible in a Year

periods.name: Early World
periods.geography: Eden, Mesopotamia, Tigris & Euphrates Valley, Babel
periods.lineage: Adam & Eve → Seth → Enoch → Noah → Shem

periods.name: Patriarchs
periods.geography: Ur, Haran, Canaan (Shechem, Bethel, Hebron), Egypt
periods.lineage: Abraham & Sarah → Isaac & Rebekah → Jacob (Israel) → 12 Tribes (Joseph & Judah)

periods.name: Egypt & Exodus
periods.geography: Goshen (Nile Delta), Red Sea, Marah, Mount Sinai (Horeb)
periods.lineage: Levi → Kohath → Amram → Moses, Aaron & Miriam

periods.name: Desert Wanderings
periods.era_date: c. 1260 – 1220 BC (40 Years in the Wilderness)
periods.geography: Sinai Wilderness, Kadesh-Barnea, Edom, Plains of Moab

periods.name: Conquest & Judges
periods.geography: Jordan River, Jericho, Shiloh, Hill Country of Ephraim & Judah
periods.lineage: Joshua → Deborah, Gideon, Samson → Ruth & Boaz → Samuel

periods.name: Royal Kingdom
periods.geography: Gibeah, Hebron, Jerusalem (City of David & Mount Moriah Temple)

periods.name: Divided Kingdom
periods.geography: Samaria (Northern Kingdom of Israel) & Jerusalem (Southern Kingdom of Judah)
periods.lineage: Rehoboam, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Hezekiah (South) | Jeroboam, Ahab, Elijah & Elisha (North)

periods.name: Exile
periods.geography: Nineveh (Assyria), Jerusalem in Ruins, Babylon (Chebar Canal)
periods.lineage: Josiah → Jehoiachin & Zedekiah | Prophets Jeremiah, Ezekiel, Daniel

periods.name: Return
periods.geography: Babylon, Susa, Rebuilt Jerusalem & Second Temple
periods.lineage: Zerubbabel (Davidic Heir), Joshua the High Priest, Ezra, Nehemiah, Esther

periods.name: Maccabean Revolt
periods.geography: Modin, Judea, Rededicated Temple in Jerusalem

periods.name: Messianic Fulfillment
periods.geography: Nazareth, Bethlehem, Sea of Galilee, Jerusalem, Golgotha, Emmaus
periods.lineage: Jesus of Nazareth, Son of David, Son of Abraham, Incarnate Word

periods.name: The Church
periods.era_date: AD 33 – c. AD 95 (Apostolic Era & New Jerusalem)
periods.geography: Jerusalem, Antioch, Ephesus, Corinth, Rome, Patmos
periods.lineage: Peter, Paul, John & the Twelve Apostles → The Universal Church

historical_context.geography: The Cosmic Temple & The Garden of Eden (Four Rivers)
historical_context.lineage: God the Creator → Adam & Eve (Humanity in the Divine Image)
historical_context.summary: God speaks cosmos out of chaos in seven liturgical days, crowning humanity as royal priests inside the Sanctuary of Eden.
historical_context.summary_ml: ദൈവം തന്റെ വചനത്താൽ പ്രപഞ്ചത്തെ ക്രമപ്പെടുത്തുകയും മനുഷ്യനെ തന്റെ ഛായയിലും സാദൃശ്യത്തിലും സൃഷ്ടിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
historical_context.reflection_prompt: Where in your life today is God inviting you to say 'Ephphatha — Be Opened' to His creative light and peace?

2.episode_title: The Fall & The First Promise of Redemption

historical_context.summary: Distrust fractures humanity's communion with God, yet in Genesis 3:15 (the Protoevangelium), God immediately promises a Redeemer who will crush the serpent.
historical_context.summary_ml: മനുഷ്യൻ അനുസരണക്കേടിലൂടെ പറുദീസ നഷ്ടപ്പെടുത്തുന്നുവെങ്കിലും, ഉൽപത്തി 3:15-ൽ ദൈവം രക്ഷകനെ വാഗ്ദാനം ചെയ്യുന്നു.
historical_context.reflection_prompt: When we hide in shame like Adam, God still walks into the garden calling 'Where are you?' How can you bring your honest heart to Him today?

3.episode_title: Noah & The Great Flood: Covenant Renewed

historical_context.summary: God preserves a righteous remnant through the waters of the flood, establishing a universal covenant marked by the bow in the clouds.
historical_context.summary_ml: ദൈവം നീതിമാനായ നോഹയെയും കുടുംബത്തെയും സംരക്ഷിക്കുകയും ജീവജാലങ്ങളുമായി ഉടമ്പടി സ്ഥാപിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
historical_context.reflection_prompt: God remembered Noah amidst the storm. In what turbulent situation do you need to anchor your trust in God's faithfulness?

4.episode_title: The Tower of Babel & The Dispersion of Nations

historical_context.summary: Humanity seeks prideful autonomy at Babel; God scatters them, setting the stage for the call of Abram in Genesis 12 to bring worldwide blessing.
historical_context.summary_ml: ബാബേൽ ഗോപുര നിർമ്മാണത്തിലൂടെ മനുഷ്യൻ അഹങ്കരിക്കുന്നു; ദൈവം ഭാഷകൾ കൂട്ടിക്കുഴച്ച് ജനങ്ങളെ ചിതറിക്കുന്നു.
historical_context.reflection_prompt: Where am I building my own towers of self-reliance instead of resting in God's divine provision?

5.episode_title: The Call of Abram: Threefold Covenant Promise

historical_context.geography: Ur of the Chaldeans → Haran → Shechem & Bethel
historical_context.summary: God calls Abram out of Mesopotamia and promises him Land, a Royal Nation, and Worldwide Blessing (Genesis 12:1–3), forming the backbone of Salvation History.
historical_context.summary_ml: ദൈവം അബ്രാമിനെ വിളിക്കുകയും ഭൂമിയിലെ സകല വംശങ്ങൾക്കും അനുഗ്രഹമാകുമെന്ന് വാഗ്ദാനം ചെയ്യുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
historical_context.reflection_prompt: Abram stepped out without knowing every detail of the destination. What step of faith is God asking you to take this week?

27.episode_title: The Burning Bush & The Divine Name (I AM)

historical_context.summary: Enslaved in Egypt, Israel cries out. From the unconsumed Burning Bush, God reveals His covenant name YHWH ('I AM WHO I AM') and commissions Moses.
historical_context.summary_ml: ഇസ്രായേലിന്റെ നിലവിളി കേട്ട ദൈവം എരിയുന്ന മുൾപ്പടർപ്പിലൂടെ മോശയ്ക്ക് പ്രത്യക്ഷപ്പെട്ട് തന്റെ നാമം വെളിപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു.
historical_context.reflection_prompt: God told Moses: 'I have seen the affliction of my people... and I have come down to deliver them.' Where do you need to trust that God sees your struggle?

298.episode_title: Ephphatha: The Word Made Flesh & The Healing of the Deaf-Mute

historical_context.geography: Sea of Galilee, Decapolis, Nazareth, Jerusalem
historical_context.lineage: Jesus the Messiah, Son of God
historical_context.summary: In the fullness of time, the Eternal Word becomes flesh. Looking up to heaven, Jesus sighs and speaks the Aramaic word 'Ephphatha' ('Be Opened'), unbinding ears to hear God's Word and tongues to proclaim His praise.
historical_context.summary_ml: യേശു സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലേക്ക് നോക്കി നെടുവീർപ്പിട്ടുകൊണ്ട് 'എഫ്ഫാത്താ' (തുറക്കപ്പെടട്ടെ) എന്ന് അരുളിച്ചെയ്യുന്നു; അവന്റെ കാതുകൾ തുറക്കപ്പെടുകയും നാവിന്റെ കെട്ട് അഴിയുകയും ചെയ്തു.
historical_context.reflection_prompt: As Christ touches your ears and heart today saying 'Ephphatha — Be Opened', what spiritual deafness or hesitation are you surrendering to Him?
